item: Row 435: a failed sqlite3 open is never held over into the next test
summary: Row 310's sweep tests and the R826 "never named" test failed under xdist, alone they passed. Cause: a sqlite3.connect that raises never reports its handle, so src.database.connect counts it as an open in flight for 60 s and no reader sweep of that minute closes a parked store_reader descriptor; many erase, copy and staging tests make such an open on purpose, and the next tests on the same worker saw descriptors outlive their close. Not a product path: a reader descriptor of ours pins the inode, so the R819 keyed-evidence answer it gives is sound (test_erase_encryption_state_r819 relies on it). The autouse fixture _no_failed_open_held_over clears the pending opens after each test; no test is skipped.
